job.title: Customer Service Representative
job.description:
Customer Service Representative
Full-time | Permanent
Sydney CBD – In-office role
Salary: $72k + Super

About the Organisation

This well-respected professional membership organisation represents and supports the legal profession across NSW, delivering a broad range of services to its members and to the public. It is a multi-functional organisation, with Customer Experience operating as their key member engagement function. The Customer Experience team is growing and genuinely busy, but stays small and close-knit, so everyone’s contribution is visible and valued. It is a professional, values-driven environment with a strong reputation.

About the Role

As Customer Service Representative, you will be the first point of contact for external enquiries, handling interactions across phone, email, web chat and social media with professionalism and care. You will triage incoming enquiries based on urgency and complexity, ensuring each one reaches the right person or team quickly and efficiently. This is a hands-on, varied role within a small, busy and growing Customer Experience team, suited to someone who thrives on keeping people informed and supported while juggling competing priorities. You will play a key part in supporting the organisation’s broader goal of delivering an outstanding experience for its members and the public.


Duties

  • Respond promptly and professionally to enquiries received by phone, email, web chat and other channels.
  • Triage incoming enquiries, assessing urgency and complexity, and route them to the appropriate person or team.
  • Communicate messages accurately and promptly to ensure expectations are managed and enquiries resolved efficiently.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed records of interactions to support continuous improvement of service processes.
  • Provide administrative support, including data entry, mailouts and report collation, to keep the team running smoothly.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in a customer service role, ideally handling enquiries across multiple channels.
  • Strong administrative and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other relevant software, including CRM and call routing platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a clear, customer-first approach.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the next step for you, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Regulatory Administration Officer
job.description:
Regulatory Administration Officer
6m FTC – likely to extend
Sydney CBD – In-office
Salary: Up to $84k + Super

Do you have strong administration skills, thrive on accuracy, and enjoy working in a structured, process-driven environment? This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the regulation of the legal profession in NSW.

About the Role
As the Regulatory Administration Officer, you will be responsible for processing and assessing applications for practising certificates and licence renewals for solicitors in New South Wales. This role is central to ensuring the integrity of the licensing system, supporting them to meet their professional obligations, and assisting with the management of high-volume regulatory processes.

Working as part of a collaborative team, you will manage applications, maintain records, liaise with professional service firms, and process financial transactions while delivering excellent service to internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess and process applications for new and varied solicitor licences.
  • Process licence renewals and related payments.
  • Liaise with external stakeholders to facilitate payment and allocation of licences.
  • Maintain accurate data and records.
  • Respond to telephone and email enquiries from solicitors, staff, and the public.
  • Process financial payments and refunds as required.
  • Provide general administrative support, including electronic and paper filing.

About You

  • To succeed in this role, you will bring:
  • Demonstrated administration experience, ideally within a regulatory or professional services environment.
  • Experience in processing high-volume applications or transactions with a strong focus on accuracy.
  • Customer service experience with the ability to liaise effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing demands.
  • High level of attention to detail and ability to maintain concentration during repetitive tasks.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, databases, email, and internet applications.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong integrity, professionalism, and discretion.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Motivated and resilient, with the ability to manage deadlines and repetitive processing tasks.
  • Commitment to delivering accurate, timely, and high-quality outcomes.

👉 Apply Now to join the team and play a key role in supporting the licensing of solicitors in NSW

job.title: Showroom Consultant
job.description:
Showroom Consultant
$75k + Super
UNDERWOOD, QLD - 4119
Permanent - Full-time
On-site role (Monday – Friday 9 – 5 only)

Cox Purtell is currently working with a world-renowned, family-owned global leader in functional furniture fittings, who are seeking a dedicated and customer-focused individual to join their team as a Showroom Consultant. Their products are trusted in kitchens and homes around the world, and as a family-owned company, they place a genuine emphasis on their people, offering real opportunities for career growth and development within a global organisation.

Role Overview:
Reporting to the State Sales Manager, as Showroom Consultant you would plan and deliver marketing and sales activities to grow the product range within their showroom market. It's a great fit for someone with an interest in design, CAD/CAM or architecture, including recent graduates or someone without formal qualifications, who is keen to bring that passion into a hands-on, customer-facing environment.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Customer Support:

  • Responsible for greeting customers and supporting them through their visit at the Showroom.
  • Responsible for answering incoming calls in a timely and professional manner.
  • Responsible for maintaining customer/visitor registration database.
  • Maintain and develop existing and new customers face-to-face through appropriate propositions and ethical sales methods.
  • Where required, support all staff in preparing for customer visits, trade events, or VIP customer visits.
  • Attend and assist in representing the organisation at trade shows, exhibitions and special events as required.
  • Responsible for follow up calls, communications and campaigns as required.

Administrative:

  • Perform general administration duties as required within the role and in a timely fashion (maintaining files, records & documents).
  • Ensure showroom and aligned state is well maintained including:
  • Appearance, cleanliness and hygiene.
  • Working order of displays and equipment.
  • Building maintenance as per lease agreements.
  • Ensure marketing material and brochures are readily available.

Planning:

  • Through internal training and product knowledge, be competent in presenting specific topics to a variety of audiences.
  • Utilise internal program to maintain and develop a computerised customer and prospect database.
  • Assist with new product release campaigns, functions and training programs as required.

Skills & Experience:

  • Well-developed inter-personal skills.
  • Solid organization skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Problem solving and time management skills.
  • Effective verbal, presentation and listening communications skills.
  • Effective written communications skills.
  • Some exposure to design, CAD/CAM, architecture or a similar creative or technical field would be highly regarded, whether through study, work experience or personal interest. Recent graduates and candidates without formal qualifications are encouraged to apply.
  • Previous experience/exposure to an internal sales environment particularly in relation to kitchen hardware would be highly regarded.

Why Apply?

  • Be part of a world-renowned, family-owned company with a strong focus on people, quality and values.
  • Genuine opportunities for growth and development within a global organisation.
  • Work with a dynamic team committed to delivering exceptional customer service.
  • A great fit for someone with a passion for design, CAD/CAM or architecture who wants to bring that interest to life in a customer-facing role.
  • If you're a customer-focused individual with a passion for providing outstanding service and technical support, we want to hear from you! Apply now and become a part of the team.

job.title: AEM Customer Success Manager
job.description:
AEM Customer Success Manager

Our client is a global software company whose digital experience products sit behind some of the most recognisable brands and websites in the world. Their APAC Customer Success team works with a large enterprise portfolio, helping organisations get genuine commercial return from significant technology investments. The culture is collaborative, data-informed and genuinely customer-obsessed, with the scale and structure you would expect from a major multinational and the autonomy to shape how you work. This is a permanent role based in Sydney CBD with hybrid working.

About the role

As a Solutions Customer Success Manager you will act as the trusted advisor across a portfolio of enterprise customers, working in a dynamic one-to-many model through fixed-scope engagements. Your focus is adoption and value: quickly pinpointing where a customer is underusing their solutions, running the engagement that closes that gap, and evidencing the outcome in a value summary co-owned with your stakeholders. You will work across the enterprise book of business to reach the customers who need help most, ideally before they know they need it. It is a role for someone who enjoys deep product expertise, commercial conversations and the pace of moving between engagements rather than sitting on a single account.

Duties

      • Own overall customer success across an enterprise portfolio, driving feature adoption, improving customer health and evidencing confirmed value delivered.
      • Scope and deliver fixed-timeframe engagements, identifying specific areas of improvement and executing against them within the agreed scope.
      • Align engagement outcomes to value summaries co-owned with key customer stakeholders, so customer value and commercial value move together.
      • Run customer workshops and advisory sessions that showcase best practice and new ways to extend digital maturity across the product suite.
      • Analyse adoption data and customer feedback to spot patterns, recommend improvements and surface areas of unmet demand, then feed that intelligence back internally as the voice of the customer.

Requirements

      • Five or more years of relevant experience, ideally across digital or experience marketing, content management or customer journey management.
      • Two or more years of hands-on solution expertise with Adobe Technology in AEM sites and AEM assets including EDS.
      • Background in a large SaaS environment or another major multinational, working with enterprise-scale customers.
      • Working knowledge of AI and agent capabilities, with content supply chain and modern delivery architecture exposure highly regarded.
      • Proven track record as a trusted advisor, translating product capability into business ROI and measurable customer value.
      • Consulting or business consulting experience, with the commercial mindset to hold value conversations at a senior level.
      • Strong stakeholder and interpersonal skills, including the ability to navigate and mediate conflict and build durable partnerships.
      • Ability to prioritise across multiple concurrent engagements and perform effectively under pressure.
      • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
      • Flexibility to travel approximately 20% of the time.
      • Bachelor's or master's degree.
      • Full Australian working rights.

How to apply

If this sounds like the next step for you, we would love to hear from you, so please apply with an up to date CV for immediate consideration.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Project Accountant
Full-time permanent role
Redfern (WFH flexibility) | Full time | $90,000–$100,000 + super

  • Redfern with genuine work-from-home flexibility offered
  • Own end-to-end project finance for a fast-growing creative agency across Sydney and APAC
  • Hands-on, varied role offering real autonomy and close exposure to production teams daily

About the client

Our client is a dynamic, fast-growing agency with a well-established presence across the Asia-Pacific region, including offices in Sydney and Singapore. Known for delivering high-quality creative and production work for a diverse portfolio of clients, the business has built a reputation for commercial rigour paired with a genuinely collaborative culture. Finance sits close to the action here, partnering directly with Producers and Account Leads rather than operating at arm's length. It is a business that values precision, integrity and strong working relationships as much as the numbers themselves.

About the role

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for a Project Accountant ready to take ownership of the full financial lifecycle of projects, from revenue recognition and billing through to job costing and final reconciliations. Reporting to the APAC Controller and working closely with Producers and Account Leads, you will become the financial backbone behind projects delivered across Sydney and Singapore. Based in Redfern with the flexibility to work from home, this role offers genuine variety, autonomy and the opportunity to make a visible commercial impact within a close-knit, supportive finance team.

Duties

  • Own project job costing, setting up vendors and maintaining accurate project costs across operating and finance systems.
  • Review and match purchase orders and vendor invoices against project budgets and deliverables, monitoring PO closures ahead of final reconciliation.
  • Manage vendor and freelancer onboarding and compliance across the APAC region, including Certificates of Insurance, Master Service Agreements, rate cards and Scopes of Work.
  • Oversee the APAC accounts payable and receivable function, including invoice processing, aging management, weekly payment runs and supplier reconciliations.
  • Support month-end close by performing bank reconciliations, processing general journals and assisting with GL reconciliations.

Requirements

  • Accounting degree or equivalent qualification.
  • 3–5 years' accounting experience, ideally with a focus on agency finance or project accounting.
  • Strong Excel skills and proficiency with accounting software; experience with Procim is highly regarded.
  • Solid understanding of GST compliance requirements across Australia and Singapore.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with producers, account managers and external vendors.
  • A self-motivated, proactive problem solver comfortable prioritising across multiple projects and dynamic teams.

How to apply

If you're a commercially minded accountant who thrives on ownership, variety and being close to the action, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Associate Sales Operation Analyst
job.description:
Associate Sales Operations Analyst

12-Month Contract | $99,000 + Super | Sydney, Hybrid

We're partnering with a Fortune 500 client, a large, well-established global technology company with a strong presence across the enterprise software sector, to find an Associate Sales Operations Analyst for a 12-month, Sydney-based hybrid contract. They offer a collaborative, data-driven environment with genuine exposure to senior stakeholders and global systems.

About the role

As Associate Sales Operations Analyst, you'll own coverage, ramp and CRM data for your assigned region, working closely with BDR leadership to keep territory planning accurate and actionable. You'll translate data such as attainment trends, ARR movement and close-date shifts into clear insights that inform staffing, coverage and capacity decisions, partnering closely with senior stakeholders along the way.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own coverage, ramp and CRM hygiene data for the assigned region, acting as the primary point of contact for these datasets.
  • Build and maintain attainment reporting for BDR leadership cadences, translating territory-level signals into inputs for the global capacity model.
  • Run recurring diagnostic checks, including weekly ARR and close-date movement analysis, escalating and acting on anomalies as they arise.
  • Maintain territory assignments and headcount status, proactively flagging coverage gaps and staffing needs to the Capacity and Annual Planning Manager.
  • Partner with regional BDR leaders on territory planning questions, data requests and broader operational improvements.

Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, Marketing Operations, Go-to-Market or a related function, ideally within the software industry.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance or a related field.
  • Strong data analysis skills across Excel, SQL, Tableau or similar tools.
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Dynamics, plus tools like Outreach.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Power BI is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and a genuine commitment to data accuracy.
  • Comfort working with planning, coverage and staffing models, and translating data into actionable business insights.

job.title: IT Systems / Migration Analyst
job.description:
About the Client

Our client is a major national construction contractor with a long-standing reputation for delivering complex projects across Australia. They combine established industry standing with a genuinely well-run internal IT function, backed by clear processes and a supportive, hands-on management style. It's an organisation where the scope of the work is well defined and the path to getting it done has already been mapped out.

About the Role

This is a hands-on opportunity to support a Cloud Document Management migration, moving data from on-premise servers into Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, with archived material transferred through to Azure Archive Tier. You'll work through a well-documented, repeatable process rather than building one from scratch, running and adjusting pre-built migration scripts and coordinating directly with business stakeholders to schedule and communicate each cutover. It's a role suited to someone who wants structured, meaningful technical experience without the ambiguity of an undefined project.

Duties

  • Engage with business stakeholders to identify, assess and prepare data for migration.
  • Create and configure Microsoft Teams and SharePoint sites in line with a national naming convention.
  • Execute file and data migrations from on-premise servers to Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and Azure Archive Tier.
  • Validate migrated data and liaise with stakeholders to schedule and communicate cutovers.
  • Maintain migration documentation and support the decommissioning of legacy Windows servers.

Requirements

  • Australian citizenship is mandatory
  • 2+ years' experience in an IT Support, Systems Administration or Cloud Migration role.
  • Certificate IV, Diploma or equivalent qualification in IT or a related field.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, including SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams.
  • Basic PowerShell skills, with the confidence to adjust pre-built scripts rather than write new ones.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills, with a genuine commitment to data integrity.
  • Available to work five days a week on-site in Melbourne for the full two-month term.

If this sounds like the right next step, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Operations Manager
job.description:
Retail Operations Manager | QSR Industry | Premium Brand
Sydney | Full-time, Permanent
Salary depending on experience, $90-120k+

  • Lead a premium retail brand
  • Step into a leadership role, not a turnaround, with a proven, reliable team in place

About the Client
This business is a premium, highly creative retail brand known across Sydney for its playful, story driven approach to product and experience. Its offering leans into bold and imaginative formats that go well beyond what's standard in the industry. The brand has built a loyal following through a distinctive point of difference in a crowded category and is now expanding its physical footprint with a new site opening alongside its flagship location. It operates with a clear focus on protecting its standards as it grows.

About the Role
You will take on day-to-day leadership of the brand's flagship Sydney CBD store, with a strong and experienced team already in place to support you. This is a leadership and standards role rather than a turnaround, focused on protecting the customer experience, driving commercial performance and developing the people already on the ground. It will suit someone who thrives on maintaining a high bar in a premium, detail-driven environment.

Duties

  • Lead day to day operations across the store and events, ensuring consistent brand standards and service.
  • Manage labour planning, rostering and cost control to support commercial performance targets.
  • Maintain compliance with food safety, WHS and other regulatory requirements across all locations.
  • Coach and develop store managers and team leaders, building their capability and supporting succession planning.

Requirements

  • Proven experience leading operations in food and beverage retail, hospitality or premium QSR, ideally across more than one site.
  • Demonstrated experience in labour planning, cost control and delivering against commercial targets.
  • Working knowledge of food safety and WHS compliance obligations in a retail or hospitality setting.
  • Experience coaching, developing and supporting store managers or team leaders.
  • Comfortable working a rotating roster that includes one weekend in every two.
  • Strong personal presentation and customer experience focus suited to a premium, brand-led environment.

job.title: Customer Success Lead - Digital
job.description:
Customer/Digital Success Lead - iMIS
Melbourne, Hybrid | Open to Sydney, Adelaide or Brisbane
Permanent full-time, package depending on experience

A specialist technology consultancy working exclusively with membership organisations, associations and unions is looking for an experienced Digital Success Lead to join their growing Australian team. With a client base of 150+ organisations across Australia and globally, and partnerships with leading platforms including iMIS, Salesforce and Fonteva, this is a business that helps membership organisations reduce digital transformation risk, align technology with strategy and make their systems work in practice.

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced NFP or associations professional with deep iMIS expertise to move into a solution leadership role, owning the alignment between a client's investment objectives and the system being delivered.

About the Role

This is not a technical delivery role. It is a relationship-led, solution leadership position for someone who deeply understands how membership organisations and associations operate, and can hold a client and delivery team to that understanding throughout an implementation.

As Digital Success Lead, you will own the alignment between the client's investment objectives and the solution being delivered. You will ensure the implementation exploits iMIS's native capability, drive operational change over customisation, and establish the foundation for the client's ongoing Digital Success program.

About You

  • 8+ years in enterprise or membership-system implementations, with deep functional command of iMIS, including demonstrated experience leading a complete implementation lifecycle from discovery through go-live, not limited to configuration, support or add-on module work
  • Previous experience working within an association, member-based organisation or NFP is essential
  • Certified iMIS Professional (CIP) or equivalent highly regarded
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executives and push back on delivery teams, without owning day-to-day project management duties
  • Business-process and change-management fluency, comfortable measuring adoption and value realisation
  • A natural communicator who can engage and influence at a senior level
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear solutions
  • Self-driven, proactive and comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy

Why This Role

  • Join a genuinely specialist consultancy with deep expertise in a sector you already know and care about
  • Work with a global team of straight-talking specialists across Australia, the UK and Europe
  • Trusted by over 150 organisations worldwide across the associations, unions and NFP sector
  • Flexible hybrid working, Melbourne-based with options considered in Sydney, Adelaide or Brisbane
  • A collaborative, values-led business with a strong reputation and a growing Australian client base

If you have built your career in the associations or NFP sector, know iMIS inside out, and are ready to move from delivery into solution leadership, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
job.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager

$180k + Super | Hybrid working | 12 month FTC with potential for extension

About the client

Our client is a globally recognised technology company known for its creative, marketing and digital experience software, used by millions of professionals and businesses worldwide. With a significant presence across the APAC region, the business has built a reputation for innovation, collaboration and a genuine focus on customer experience. It continues to invest in its regional lifecycle marketing capability as part of a broader growth strategy across the APAC market.

About the role

This is an opportunity to lead lifecycle marketing strategy across the APAC region, owning end-to-end campaigns that guide customers from acquisition through to long-term engagement and retention. You will design and manage journeys across email and other owned channels, working closely with regional and global teams to localise and adapt these programs for APAC markets. The role also spans customer engagement and product adoption initiatives, giving you real scope to influence how customers discover and get value from the platform. You will use data, segmentation and experimentation to continually sharpen performance and identify new opportunities for automation across the team.

Duties

  • Develop and execute lifecycle marketing strategies that span the full customer journey, from acquisition through engagement and retention.
  • Own end-to-end campaigns across email and other owned channels, including automated journeys and one-time initiatives.
  • Design and optimise customer segmentation, targeting and personalisation strategies in partnership with global teams.
  • Manage engagement programs across in-product communications and other lifecycle touchpoints to drive feature discovery and product adoption.
  • Define and track lifecycle KPIs, analyse campaign performance and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

Requirements

  • 8 to 10 years' experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM or email marketing.
  • Proven track record developing and executing lifecycle marketing programs across acquisition, engagement and retention.
  • Strong understanding of segmentation, journey orchestration, marketing automation and email marketing best practice.
  • Experience designing automated customer journeys and omnichannel lifecycle programs.
  • Results-driven with a strong analytical mindset and the ability to use data to solve complex marketing challenges.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills across regional, global and cross-functional matrix organisations.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

How to apply

If this sounds like the next step in your lifecycle marketing career, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Principal Salesforce Business Analyst
job.description:
About the Client

Our client is a major Australian university delivering an enterprise Salesforce Education Cloud transformation. Operating within a modern, value-driven Digital Solutions function, the organisation is reshaping how it engages students, staff, alumni and the broader community. It is investing heavily in contemporary ways of working and platform capability to build a genuinely digital future. This is a well-funded, executive-sponsored program with real momentum behind it.

About the Role

This is a 24-month fixed term opportunity based in Brisbane. The role is mostly on-site with some hybrid flexibility. As Principal Salesforce Business Analyst, you will provide enterprise-level business analysis leadership for a complex, multi-stakeholder Salesforce transformation. You will lead the analysis of intricate business requirements and provide authoritative advice to senior stakeholders, program leaders and technical teams. This is a hands-on strategic role: you will shape scalable, fit-for-purpose Salesforce solutions that align with organisational priorities and long-term digital objectives. You will also mentor other business analysts, helping to lift capability across the wider team.

Duties

  • Lead the elicitation, analysis and translation of complex business requirements into functional specifications, user stories and process models.
  • Provide expert business analysis advice to senior stakeholders and program leaders to shape enterprise-wide Salesforce solutions.
  • Drive backlog governance, prioritisation and delivery planning in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
  • Lead business assurance and user acceptance testing activities, resolving complex functional issues along the way.
  • Mentor business analysts and project team members, promoting best-practice business analysis methodologies.

  • Demonstrated experience eliciting, analysing and documenting business requirements into clear functional specifications and solution artefacts.
  • Demonstrated experience with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise CRM platform, including configuration, data structures and security concepts.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum or other iterative delivery environments.


If this sounds like your next move, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Professional Services Manager & Technical Support
job.description:
Technical Support & Professional Services Manager
Sydney – Rosebery | Onsite with free parking | Full-time permanent
$140,000 – $150,000 + super + bonus

If you've built your career at the intersection of broadcast technology and customer relationships, and you're ready to lead a team across one of the most dynamic regions in the world, this is worth your attention.

We are working exclusively with a world-leading business whose products are used in high-end, large-scale events. Their technology is trusted on the world's biggest stages across broadcast, live events, pro-audio, sports, theatre, and security applications. And despite their global reach, they've retained a local, family feel to their operations in Sydney.

Now they need someone to lead their APAC technical support and professional services team.

This is a working manager position within the Customer Success and Product Division. You'll bring structured leadership, customer engagement discipline, and escalation management to a technically capable but geographically distributed engineering team. Around 60% of your time is customer-facing; the other 40% keeps you close enough to the technology to be credible with your team and your clients.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the technical support and professional services engineering team, based across Australia and Southeast Asia
  • Own the coordination and delivery of technical support across the APAC region
  • Oversee professional services delivery, including project management, commissioning, and training
  • Engage with SLA customers alongside the Sales and Customer Success teams
  • Own escalation management and relationship recovery where required
  • Represent the business at customer-facing and industry events
  • Monitor team engagement cadence and resolve roadblocks
